body.statement: For every compact \(C\subseteq\{\Sigma\in U:g(\Sigma)=0\}\), there are a neighborhood \(W\) of \(C\) with \(\overline W\subset U\) and constants \(0<c<C_1<\infty\) such that, for \(\Sigma\in W\) with \(g(\Sigma)\le0\), \[\operatorname{dist}(\Sigma,K_{+1})=\operatorname{dist}(\Sigma,\{\Theta\in U:g(\Theta)=0\}),\qquad c|g(\Sigma)|\le\operatorname{dist}(\Sigma,K_{+1})\le C_1|g(\Sigma)|.\]
body.justification: The statement connects the explicit algebraic certificate margin to the metric clearance used by the recovery theorem.
body.gap: FangSantos2019 supplies general tangent-cone tools but not this one-sided OU boundary-distance equivalence or the buffer excluding remote model components.
body.consumer: Certificate-based clearance can be interpreted and calibrated as local covariance distance on regular contact subcharts.
